footer_desc: A measurement instrument for the space between visits. Built in Jamshedpur for phones that are shared, batteries that are low, and clinics that are far away.
footer_not_medical: Not a medical device. No affiliation with Zhongshan Hospital, HIMSS or any named health system.
footer_demo_not_medical: Demo only · not a medical device · no affiliation with Zhongshan Hospital, HIMSS or any named health system.
head_hospital: The hospital is the unit of change.
head_blueprint: A closed loop, built for the places a hospital never reaches.
head_security: What is protected, and what is not.
lead_functions: This is the full pattern the project follows, from a phone-based measurement instrument to a clinician-supervised closed loop. Each function is marked as Shipped, Demo or Roadmap with a named precondition.
lead_hospital: A phone record only closes a loop when a clinic can act on it. This page is a reference architecture for that hospital layer. It is a design blueprint: nothing here is deployed and no hospital is named as a partner.
lead_demo: The same record shape, the same food library and the same rules as the Android build, running entirely in this page. Not for real clinical records.
rule_human: The rule across every row: software reads first, a human decides.
hospital_s2: Why the hospital, not just the phone
callout_blueprint: Read this as a blueprint, not an announcement: no hospital deployment, pilot, endorsement or partnership is claimed.
callout_honest: The honest line: the participant app and the browser demo exist today. Every hospital component here is a design proposal.
draft_notice: Draft translation — requires native-speaker review before clinical use.
